Sex-structured operating model example (dimorphic stock)

Source: R/sex_om.R
dimorph_om.Rd

A sex-structured operating model built with om_sex() (script dev/make_dimorph_om.R): females Linf 60 cm, k 0.15, L50 35 cm; males Linf 45 cm, k 0.25, L50 28 cm; M = 0.3; Beverton-Holt steepness 0.7; 1976-2025, 10 iterations, F history from fapic_fudc() (up to 2.5 Fmsy, then 1.5 Fmsy), AR1 recruitment deviations (sigR 0.5, rho 0.3). A trawl fishery (dome-shaped selectivity, mode 34 cm) and a survey (logistic, 50% at 12 cm) with the life history and sampling of FLicc's data(dimorph).

Usage

data(dimorph_om)

Format

A list with om (om_sex() result), lh (lh_sex()), sel (trawl selectivity), survey_sel, lfd (FLQuants of iteration 1: Trawl 400 unsexed fish a year and Survey 250 sexed fish a year from 2016, 2011-2025), lhpar (life history for FLicc::stocklen_sex()) and truth (true status of iteration 1).
